name: Sergeant Varn
title: The Vale Ward
examine: First posting as a sergeant, newest wall in the city, and absolutely determined that neither fact will show. The Vale Gate's paperwork has never been so thorough.
lines: The young wall, the young watch. We heard it. We repeat it ourselves now, which ruins it for everybody else.
Everything enters through this gate or the Silver Gate above, and the Silver Gate's watch has seniority, tenure, and opinions. We have the kettle and the actual traffic.
Marshal Kestrel walked the wall once, nodded twice, and said 'keep the braziers fed.' I have never fed anything so carefully in my life.
